name: Rite Mending
description: Perform the first step of the great rite and mend one deep wound of an ally while the field gathers.

name: Rite Cleanse
description: Cleanse a tainted ally with the second step of the rite while the gathering qi hums.

name: Hallowed Rally
description: Lend a failing ally the steady strength of the rite so it may bear the work to come.

name: Anointing Lift
description: Anoint the brow of a swooning ally with qi and lift the dizziness and pain at once.

name: Consecrated Recovery
description: Consecrate an ally's wounds with the rite and hold the healing steady through the whole span of the ritual.

name: Hallowed Revival
description: Call an ally back from the first moments of death with the full voice of the rite.

name: Sanctified Purification
description: Purify the whole body of an ally of taint and curse by the cleansing steps of the rite.

name: Gracious Restoration
description: Restore a broken ally in the grace of the rite with a flow that never rushes and never fails.

name: Benediction Remedy
description: Speak a benediction in qi over the wounded and let a remedy rise through each of them in turn.

name: Anointed Resurgence
description: Anoint the dying with the whole force of the rite and raise them from the edge of ruin.

name: Merciful Dawn
description: Raise a dawn of merciful qi over the field that mends every ally lit by it.

name: Hallowed Benediction
description: Speak the school's great benediction and let healing fall on every ally that hears it.

name: Overwhelming Grace
description: Pour the rite across a whole company at once and restore every ally in reach to health up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Coreflow Mend
description: Let qi flow from the Core through the hands in a measured stream that closes a deep wound.

name: Coreflow Rinse
description: Rinse the blood of an ally with clean qi pulled from the depth of the healer's Core.

name: Corelit Rally
description: Light the dim qi of a failing ally with a spark of the healer's Core.

name: Marrow Rekindle
description: Rekindle the marrow of an ally whose blood has gone thin with a slow warm flow of qi.

name: Corebright Recovery
description: Pour bright qi from a formed Core into a mortally wounded ally and hold the body together.

name: Corebright Revival
description: Strike the stopped heart of an ally with a lance of Core qi to restart it within the window.

name: Deepcore Purification
description: Cleanse even a taint seated in the meridian roots of an ally by working from the Core outward.

name: Dantian Resurgence
description: Raise a collapsed dantian of an ally back into working shape with qi from the healer's Core.

name: Luminous Remedy
description: Wash an ally in a luminous remedy that seeps through bone and flesh to every wounded part.

name: Radiant Absolution
description: Absolve an ally of curse and poison in one radiant wave of qi that leaves no stain.

name: Glorious Recovery
description: Give a glorious recovery to a company of fallen allies with one long breath of Core qi.

name: Coreheart Mercy
description: Give the heart of the Core to an ally in one great gift of mercy that closes the worst of the wounds.

name: Radiant Deluge
description: Release the radiance of a formed Core as a flood of healing over a great host up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Unending Daybreak
description: Raise a daybreak of qi over a battlefield of fresh dead and call back every ally whose window has not yet closed.

name: Heavenly Mend
description: Mend a wound with qi tuned to the heavens so the flesh of an ally closes with a clear note.

name: Heavenly Cleanse
description: Cleanse a body of every stain with a stream of tuned and unflagging qi.

name: Heavenly Rally
description: Raise an ally's qi in one clear stroke so strength returns beyond what was lost.

name: Empyrean Lift
description: Lift a fallen ally from the brink with a bright stroke of high qi.

name: Empyrean Recovery
description: Pour the high clear qi of the heavens through a broken body until every part has set.

name: Empyrean Revival
description: Cast the high qi of the heavens into the chest of a fresh casualty and restart life.

name: Celestial Purification
description: Purify an ally of the deepest taint and curse with a calm and endless stream of celestial qi.

name: Heavenly Restoration
description: Restore the full body of an ally with qi that arrives as if from the heavens themselves.

name: Celestial Remedy
description: Draw a celestial remedy down on an ally that mends all hurts in a single bright descent.

name: Starlit Resurgence
description: Raise a body from deep ruin under a rain of starlit qi that fills each wound.

name: Boundless Grace
description: Give boundless grace to the wounded in reach so that none of them is left without help.

name: Heaven's Mercy
description: Call down the mercy of the heavens upon the wounded and let it close their injuries.

name: Lifegiving Radiance
description: Spread a lifegiving radiance from the healer in all directions that mends every ally it touches.

name: Firmament Restoration
description: Pour a whole sky of restoring qi on a multitude and mend the wounded up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Final Hour Revival
description: Wrest back from death every ally in reach within the widest window the tier allows and set the hearts beating again.
